 AJ Dybantsa puts up 21 points in loss Monday 
 by Leo Sells | Wizards Correspondent | Tue, Nov 10th 2026, 12:31pm EST 
 AJ Dybantsa scored 21 points (8-17 FG, 1-4 3PT, 4-6 FT) to go with eight rebounds and two blocks in Monday's 122-111 loss to the Detroit Pistons. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Dybantsa scored 21 points and grabbed eight rebounds over the course of 37 minutes of action on Monday, which fantasy managers were happy with. However, he also struggled with efficiency and committed five turnovers on the night, which threw some cold water on his overall fantasy total.
